name_en: Torisashi — lightly seared chicken sliced thin and dipped in soy sauce, raw at the core
summary_ja: 刺身用の鶏肉をあぶって薄く削ぎ切りにし、青じそやおろししょうがを添えて醤油でいただく。闘鶏で負けた鶏をしめて食べた文化に連なると伝わり、県独自の生食加工基準を満たした鶏肉だけが流通している。
summary_en: Sashimi-grade chicken is lightly seared, sliced thin, and dipped in soy sauce with shiso and grated ginger. It's said to descend from a culture of eating cockfighting's losing birds, and today only chicken meeting the prefecture's own raw-poultry safety standard is sold this way.
source_title: 鶏刺し 鹿児島県｜うちの郷土料理
